1.

Faithful Saviour, now lead us Through this barren land! We are weak, Thou art mighty, Sustain us with Thy hand. Bread from heaven, Bread from heaven, Feed us on our desert path! Bread from heaven, Bread from heaven, Feed us on our desert path!

2.

Opened now is the fountain of life, The stream of health there flows forth. As with the lofty pillar of cloud Thou didst lead us to the journey’s end! Strong and mighty, Strong and mighty, Thou Thyself art our strength and shield.

3.

While we wander in the wilderness, Keep us ever near to Thee, Thou who art our salvation’s rock And our fortress evermore! Faithful art Thou, Faithful art Thou, Patient, unchanging.
